description: The ADMISSIONS table contains information about patient hospital admissions, including admission and discharge times, admission type and location, discharge location, insurance details, patient demographics (language, religion, marital status, ethnicity), diagnosis, and in-hospital mortality. It also indicates the availability of chart event data for each admission. Each row represents a unique hospital admission.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a patient.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for a patient's hospital admission.

columns.name: ADMITTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was admitted to the hospital.

columns.name: DISCHTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was discharged from the hospital.

columns.name: DEATHTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient died, if applicable. Null if the patient did not die during the hospitalization.

columns.name: ADMISSION_TYPE
columns.description: Type of admission, e.g., EMERGENCY, URGENT, or ELECTIVE.

columns.name: ADMISSION_LOCATION
columns.description: Location of the patient prior to admission.

columns.name: DISCHARGE_LOCATION
columns.description: Location to which the patient was discharged.

columns.name: INSURANCE
columns.description: Type of insurance the patient has.

columns.name: LANGUAGE
columns.description: Primary language of the patient. Note: values prefixed with '*' may indicate a need for interpretation or translation.

columns.name: RELIGION
columns.description: Patient's religion.

columns.name: MARITAL_STATUS
columns.description: Patient's marital status.

columns.name: ETHNICITY
columns.description: Patient's ethnicity.

columns.name: EDREGTIME
columns.description: Timestamp when the patient was registered in the emergency department. Only present for admissions involving the emergency department.

columns.name: EDOUTTIME
columns.description: Timestamp when the patient left the emergency department. Only present for admissions involving the emergency department.

columns.name: DIAGNOSIS
columns.description: Diagnosis given at the time of admission or during the hospital stay.

columns.name: HOSPITAL_EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: Indicates whether the patient expired (died) during the hospitalization. 1 indicates the patient expired, 0 indicates they survived to discharge.

columns.name: HAS_CHARTEVENTS_DATA
columns.description: Indicates whether the patient has data in the CHARTEVENTS table. 1 indicates they have data, 0 indicates they do not.

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in ADMISSIONS references SUBJECT_ID in PATIENTS, linking admissions to patient demographics.
HADM_ID in SERVICES references HADM_ID in ADMISSIONS, linking services to admissions.

description: The `PATIENTS` table contains demographic and mortality information for patients in the dataset. It includes unique patient identifiers, gender, date of birth, and multiple date of death records from different sources (general, hospital, and Social Security Administration). An expire flag indicates the patient's mortality status. This table serves as a core demographic reference for linking patient data across other tables in the dataset.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each patient in the dataset.

columns.name: GENDER
columns.description: The gender of the patient, with 'M' for male and 'F' for female.

columns.name: DOB
columns.description: The date of birth of the patient.

columns.name: DOD
columns.description: The date of death of the patient, recorded in the dataset.

columns.name: DOD_HOSP
columns.description: Date of death as recorded by the hospital.

columns.name: DOD_SSN
columns.description: Date of death as recorded by the Social Security Administration.

columns.name: EXPIRE_FLAG
columns.description: A binary flag indicating whether the patient has expired (1) or not (0).

description: The `SERVICES` table contains information about patient transfers between different hospital services (departments or units) during a specific hospital admission. It includes the time of transfer, the previous service the patient was in, and the current service the patient was transferred to. This table allows tracking patient movement and service utilization within the hospital.

columns.name: ROW_ID
columns.description: Unique identifier for each row in the table.

columns.name: SUBJECT_ID
columns.description: The patient identifier, unique to each patient.

columns.name: HADM_ID
columns.description: The hospital admission identifier, unique to each patient's hospital visit.

columns.name: TRANSFERTIME
columns.description: Timestamp of when the patient was transferred during the hospital admission.

columns.name: PREV_SERVICE
columns.description: The patient's previous service (department or unit) before the transfer.

columns.name: CURR_SERVICE
columns.description: The patient's current service (department or unit) after the transfer.

relationships.reason: SUBJECT_ID in SERVICES references SUBJECT_ID in PATIENTS, linking services to patient demographics.
HADM_ID in SERVICES references HADM_ID in ADMISSIONS, linking services to admissions.
